# What's new in 0.2

> Not included in the Markdown version: an interactive `ReleaseStatus` block. See it on the page: https://demogar.github.io/molaui/?path=/docs/mola-ui-what-s-new-0-2--overview

0.2 adds the fields and data screens an internal tool needs first, and makes the cut hold up in
Windows High Contrast and in right-to-left languages. The full list is at the end of this page and
on the [Changelog](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/?path=/docs/mola-ui-changelog--overview).

## The fields internal tools ask for

- **[Combobox](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/?path=/docs/components-forms-combobox--overview)** searches a long list. With
  `multiple`, each value is a chip you can see and remove. It groups options and has states for
  options that load asynchronously. `Autocomplete`, beside it, accepts free text.
- **[Date picker](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/?path=/docs/components-forms-date-picker--overview)** picks a date or a range
  on a calendar grid that follows the WAI-ARIA pattern. The range picker also takes typed start
  and end dates, and refuses an end before the start.
- **[Number input](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/?path=/docs/components-forms-number-input--overview)** formats numbers for a
  locale, and **[File upload](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/?path=/docs/components-forms-file-upload--overview)** is a dropzone
  that checks each file's type, size and count, shows progress and offers a retry.

## Tables that carry a whole admin screen

[Table](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/?path=/docs/components-data-display-table--overview)'s `DataTable` gained pagination,
server-side data (`manual`, with the total in `rowCount`), a bar for bulk actions and a Columns
menu to hide columns. Around it, [Toolbar](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/?path=/docs/components-layout-toolbar--overview) gained
toggles, an input and an overflow menu for what doesn't fit, and
[Drawer](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/?path=/docs/components-overlays-drawer--overview) opens a record from the start, the end
or the bottom of the page. The [Filtered table](https://demogar.github.io/molaui/?path=/docs/patterns-filtered-table--overview)
pattern puts them together.

## Edges in forced colours, and right-to-left

Forced-colours mode drops box shadows, and Mola's edges are box shadows, so inputs lost their
edges and switches disappeared. Each edge now draws a 1px system-colour outline in that mode, focus
is a 2px outline, and fills that carry meaning (a slider thumb, a selected item) are repainted in
system colours.

Components lay out with logical properties, so they mirror in a right-to-left page, and directional
icons flip with them. Base UI reads arrow-key direction from React context, so the library
re-exports its `DirectionProvider`: set `dir` on `<html>` for layout and wrap the app in
`DirectionProvider` for behaviour.
